# ZadonEmbark

ZadonEmbark is an international placement consultancy based in India, helping Indian students and skilled workers find verified study and work opportunities abroad.

## Services
- Study Abroad: undergraduate, postgraduate and vocational admissions in Canada, UK, Australia, Germany
- Work Abroad: skilled and semi-skilled placements in Germany, Poland, UAE
- Employer Services: sourcing pre-screened Indian talent for international businesses
- Partner Programme: collaboration with institutions and agencies

## Key Facts
- Website: https://zadonembark.com
- Contact: info@zadonembark.com
- Languages: English, Hindi

## Transparency Policy
ZadonEmbark never guarantees visa approval or job placement. All fees are disclosed upfront in writing before any engagement. The company only works with verified, licensed employers and accredited institutions.
